searchText: hey everyone, whats the best way to get 32 Sep in the Sepolia testnet to be ready for testing the upcoming merge? The faucets I know only hand out small amounts, is the only way mining myself? Sepolia is a permissioned network, you won't be able to run a validator on it. You should run a validator on prater instead for testing the merge. ok thank you for the info 🙂
